Name: Gad, David's Seer
Summary: David's seer through whom the LORD offered David three choices after the numbering.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 21:9; 1 Chronicles 21:11: David's seer through whom the LORD offered David three choices after the numbering.
LifeLesson: The mention of Gad in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
